create_dataflow_graph: create a dataflow graph instance using model_opt dataflow_graph Graph class
add_node_to_graph: add a named node to the dataflow graph using graph add_node method
add_edge_between_nodes: add a sized edge between source and sink nodes using graph add_edge method
canonicalize_graph: canonicalize the dataflow graph by converting multi-source edges to single-source edges
build_computation_graph: build a computation graph with nodes and edges representing model operations and tensors
